scope: Public operation behavior; HTTPS enrollment and routing remain owned by the unchanged service.

outcomes.failed: Worker reported failure; intermediate changes may exist
outcomes.unknown: No confirmed result after submission; never automatically replay

intentional_differences.saved_job_cancel: Native refuses saved-process signalling; inspect/reconcile instead. No PID-only cancellation is introduced.
intentional_differences.command_faults: Native strict interception remains explicit in status; full signal-handler compatibility is a later gate.
intentional_differences.owned_metadata_paths: Native file operations cannot address their own .jobs or .views directories.
intentional_differences.directory_replacement: Native refuses commit when the parent is moved/replaced; independent writers must be quiesced.
intentional_differences.legacy_unknown_records: Imported same-boot uncertain jobs stay unknown. Import is not evidence that descendants were reaped.
intentional_differences.extra_fields: Native diagnostics are additive; only documented generated fields and per-operation additions may be normalized.
intentional_differences.special_upload_destination: Native rejects existing non-regular upload destinations at begin rather than allowing a staging file first.
intentional_differences.hash_size_change: Native hashes only the initial regular-file size and refuses a changed size instead of following a growing file to EOF. Same-size external writes still require writer quiescence.

remaining_integration_gates: native-default rollout and managed fallback retirement

response_deadlines.on_expiry: unknown; close connection; do not replay; retain submitted journal entry

resource_inventory.monitor_finished: Monitor loop finished for this in-memory job; not a claim that detached descendants, output drains, or durable state are fully reconciled.
resource_inventory.handoff: Read fresh status after stopping service admissions and waiting for in-flight requests. Empty inventory alone is not evidence of quiescence; verify retained state and worker shutdown separately.

process_identity.guardian: null for managed; native guardian pid and start_ticks
process_identity.guardian_confirmation: guardian-parent-identity-v1 means this status request freshly checked the kernel parent PID against the direct guardian parent established at startup. Cached start ticks remain bound to that original parent; this does not promise future liveness or observe both pidfd exits.
process_identity.identity: Bind to boot_id, worker_id and authenticated worker PID. Preserve decimal start_ticks as a string.
process_identity.exit: BYE and disconnect precede cleanup. Observe original worker and guardian identities absent or replaced before treating process exit as verified. Mounts, detached descendants and retained state require separate reconciliation.

observer_probe.admission: Enrolled client; serialized and journaled before staging; no caller-supplied PID, path or command.
observer_probe.effect: Enable execution of the exact installed observer package member; verify service-context launch; bind/cancel on S90D or use proc-stat on QN90A; confirm the managed worker remains and release admission on success.
observer_probe.unknown: Never replay; preserve submitted request and unresolved admission hold.
